top_signals.title: Oil Prices Slide as Global Glut Fears Eclipse Hormuz Attacks
top_signals.summary: Crude oil prices extended a decline that began earlier this month, as reports about a global glut multiplied, suggesting there was no supply squeeze at all, despite continuing attacks on vessels in the Persian Gulf and the Yemeni Houthis’ strikes on Saudi Arabian energy infrastructure. At the time of writing, Brent crude was trading at $91.70 per barrel, and West Texas Intermediate was trading at $85.03 per barrel, both down from Monday’s close. top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Swiss Pharma Employee Convicted Over $300,000 in Insider Trades
top_signals.summary: An employee of Swiss healthcare supplier SKAN Group AG was found guilty of insider trading after his appeal of a penalty order handed down by Swiss prosecutors was rejected.

top_signals.title: Nike hosts first investor day in 9 years as it tries to rightsize its business
top_signals.summary: Nike is hosting an investor day at its Oregon headquarters as the company tries to prove to investors that its turnaround is working.
